_help: Seeds you control. Every entry is re-checked on each run: the page must load, robots.txt must allow it, 'must_contain' must be on the page, and a contact_email is only used if it is written on contact_source_url (for YouTube: labelled as a business contact in the channel's latest video descriptions). Each entry also records what a person checked: source_type, last_checked, eligibility (status + verified requirements + what is still uncertain) and why Ringshift fits. Only enabled entries with eligibility 'meets' or 'likely' are used; 'uncertain' ones are held. Sources looked at and turned down go in 'excluded' so nobody re-adds them by mistake. See outreach/README.md.

Basic Launch: no external ads and no external login options.
A description, controls and cover images/videos must be provided.
